TEMPERATURE-CONTROLLED LOGISTICS AGREEMENT

Client: PharmaCare Ltd

DELIVERY REQUIREMENTS:
- Temperature range: 2-8 C maintained throughout
- Delivery window: 9 hours from dispatch (30 minute grace)
- Reefer autonomy: 10 hours; beyond that an estimated 20% of the consignment is written off

PENALTY TERMS:
- Rs 8,000 per hour for delivery delays, maximum Rs 40,000
- Carrier liable for spoiled product (declared value Rs 70 lakh)

SPECIAL CONDITIONS:
- Relief vehicles must be reefer-equipped and pharma certified
